channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Video: Ohio home explosion shakes neighborhood, felt miles away
item.description: A powerful explosion in Canton, Ohio, damaged nearby homes and seriously injured two people, according to authorities.

item.title: New Jersey officer disguised as shrub catches distracted drivers on video
item.description: A New Jersey police department has adopted a new approach to catch drivers suspected of distraction.

item.title: Ukrainian ambassador reflects on evolving Kyiv-Washington ties
item.description: The outgoing Ukrainian ambassador to the U.S. says Ukraine has countered what she called a previous misleading narrative about Russia.

item.title: As diplomacy fails, US-Iran conflict escalates: ANALYSIS
item.description: The 14-point agreement with Iran signed by President Trump in mid-June was meant as a diplomatic exit.
